blocks.text: Module test A1.4 · Daily life
Instructions
Week 45 of the calendar, after verification A1-16 → A1-19. Duration: approx. 85 minutes for parts A/D, plus 10–12 minutes of conversation with the tutor. Fix it with the solution.
Overcoming. At least 38 points above 50 (75%) and at least 2 in each criterion of the headings.
A · Reading (10 points)
⁧وَصَلَتْ إِلَى مَطَارِ تُونِسَ⁩ . ⁧فِي الصَّيْفِ المَاضِي سَافَرَتْ هُدَى إِلَى تُونِسَ لِزِيَارَةِ عَائِلَةِ أَبِيهَا⁩
⁧تَسْكُنُ العَائِلَةُ فِي حَيٍّ قَدِيمٍ⁩ . ⁧يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ السَّاعَةَ الخَامِسَةَ مَسَاءً، وَكَانَ عَمُّهَا فِي المَطَارِ⁩
⁧كُلَّ صَبَاحٍ ذَهَبَتْ هُدَى إِلَى⁩ . ⁧البَيْتُ لَيْسَ كَبِيرًا، لٰكِنَّ فِيهِ حَدِيقَةً جَمِيلَةً⁩ . ⁧قَرِيبٍ مِنَ البَحْرِ⁩
⁧مَا زَارَتِ المَتَاحِفَ، لِأَنَّ الجَوَّ كَانَ حَارًّا⁩ . ⁧السُّوقِ مَعَ عَمَّتِهَا، وَبَعْدَ الظُّهْرِ سَبَحَتْ فِي البَحْرِ⁩
⁧رَجَعَتْ إِلَى مِيلَانُو بَعْدَ⁩ . ⁧تَكَلَّمَتْ بِالعَرَبِيَّةِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ، وَفَهِمَتِ الدَّارِجَةَ التُّونِسِيَّةَ قَلِيلًا⁩ . ⁧جِدًّا⁩
. ⁧أُسْبُوعَيْنِ⁩
Help: ⁧لِزِيَارَةِ⁩ To visit the site of the hotel ⁧سَبَحَتْ⁩ Swimming has been done · ⁧أُسْبُوعَيْنِ⁩ 2 weeks. Reply in English (2 points for complete response, 1 if partial).
1. When she left HudāWhere and why?
2. When did she arrive and who expected her?
3. How's the family home and where is it?
4. What did he do every day?
5. What did he not do and why? How long did the trip last?
B · Listening (8 points)
Listen to the call twice. Answer in English; 2 points per answer.
1. When she arrived Laylā Milan?
2. What does Luke do tomorrow, and until what time?
3. What does it propose? LaylāWhat time?
4. Where will they meet?
C · Language (12 points)

One point for an answer. Perfect. Write: 1. ( ⁧أَنَا، رَجَعَ⁩ ) · 2. ( ⁧هِيَ، كَتَبَ⁩ ) · 3. ( ⁧هُمْ، زَارَ⁩ ) Denial. Choose and write the right form ( ⁧لَا، لَيْسَ⁩ and shapes ⁧، مَا⁩ ): 4. . ⁧أَعْرِفُ⁩ ◌ · 5. ⁧مِصْرِيًّا⁩ (I). · 6. ⁧ذَهَبْنَا⁩ ◌
. ⁧إِلَى السُّوقِ أَمْسِ⁩
Time. Write in Arabic: 7. 9:30 · 8. 2:45 Cases. Put the endings: 9. ⁧كان الدرس طويلا⁩ · 10. ⁧إن المدينة جميلة⁩ · 11. ⁧سافر الوزير إلى القاهرة⁩ Vocabulary. 12. Write the days from Monday to Wednesday.
D · Written production (8 points)

Write about 80 words, vocalized, on your last trip or on a weekend to remember: when you left or what day it was, where, with whom, what you did (at least eight verbs to the perfect), two things you did not do ( ⁧مَا⁩ ), as was the place (with ⁧كَانَ⁩ and with ⁧لَيْسَ⁩ ), at least one hour. Evaluation: Accuracy 1–4 + Register 1–4. Each missing mandatory item removes 1 Point to Accuracy (minimum 1).
E · Oral production: guided conversation (12 points)
With the tutor, about 10 minutes.
1. The tutor asks you what you did last week and weekend.
2. Describe home and neighborhood and answer two questions with denials.
3. Make an appointment: propose two days and a time; The tutor refuses the first.
Evaluation: Accuracy 1–4 + Fluidity 1–4 + Speak 1–4.
